resources.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids–II (BASS-II) Summary Report
resources.summary: BASS-II report describing ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox experiments varying oxygen concentration, ventilation, fuel, thickness and geometry.
resources.limitations: Only the NTRS abstract and metadata were inspected; individual test tables have not been extracted from the PDF. Aggregate findings do not establish runs or safety thresholds.
resources.locator: NTRS 20210011385, abstract; published 2021-10-01

findings.text: The authors estimated heat-release rate from oxygen consumption and burn duration; most reported tests were substantially below 100 W.
CSA-CP measured O₂ and CO; a CO₂ monitor recorded conditions before and after each test. CO/CO₂ relationships varied with geometry and flow.

resources.title: Preliminary Results from the Saffire VI Experiment
resources.summary: ICES-2024-365 conference paper presenting preliminary Saffire VI results on Cygnus and comparisons with selected Saffire IV/V samples.
resources.limitations: Only the NTRS abstract was inspected. This is a preliminary report, not a raw dataset. Independent ranges and geometries must not be combined into run conditions.
resources.locator: NTRS 20240002981, abstract

findings.text: For the tests discussed in the abstract, the authors found spacecraft temperature and pressure increases less significant than increases in CO₂ and CO.

resources.title: Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction (SoFIE)
resources.summary: SoFIE investigates ignition and flammability of spacecraft solid materials. Its Combustion Integrated Rack insert supports variation of oxygen, pressure and airflow.
resources.limitations: The inspected page describes program objectives and provides no run data. Its schedule is not evidence of current operational status.
resources.locator: Facility Description; Science Objectives

resources.title: SoFIE — Growth and Extinction Limit (GEL)
resources.summary: SoFIE-GEL investigates flame growth and extinction around thick PMMA spheres, considering airflow, oxygen concentration, pressure and internal heating.
resources.limitations: The page describes experiment design and objectives, not individual run conditions. Lunar-gravity behavior cannot be inferred from this description.

resources.title: Flammability Limits At Reduced-g Experiment (FLARE)
